mostWorthwhile.text: Adding bone cells to the mineralised framework was most worthwhile: the planned cutaway connects living embedded cells to one another through tiny channels, making bone more than an inert scaffold.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding cartilage was a fairly predictable fitting step, although the sliding-surface inset clarified its purpose.

surprise.text: The lineage picture showed that some matrix-producing osteoblasts become embedded osteocytes, connecting bone formation to the living cells in mature bone.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the sequence of adding bone components was largely guided by the available pieces rather than a demanding choice.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the planned cutaways connect structure to function, especially in the bone channels and fluid-filled elbow, though the combinations themselves were mostly predictable.
